svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A saw cycle cut into 11 octave bands
svg.desc: The 11 octave bands of a saw cycle drawn one under the other, each with its number of atoms; the finest bands show short bursts at the place where the saw jumps. Added up they give back the saw exactly.
svg.text: One cycle of a saw = the sum of 11 octave bands
Each row is drawn at its own height (the % is its real size against the biggest band). Band 1 is the slow body of the
wave, band 11 the finest detail; the bursts of the fine bands sit where the saw jumps: wavelets know where things
